thread:
anya: Quick sync  propose a small 'adapter' layer per cloud to map canonical refkit modules to marketplace packaging (thin terraform wrappers + metadata). Reduces duplication and keeps modules provider-agnostic. Thoughts?

marco: Strong yes. Adapters should be trivial wrappers + metadata.yaml. Keeps module code clean.

tess: From partnerships: must include listing checklist (legal, logos, SLA), one-click examples, and cost guidance (GPU SKUs).

sam: CI note: have matrix jobs validate adapters across providers but only publish when PR has publish label. Also include terratest plan-only checks to limit spend.

ci-bot: CI created: adapters/ci/matrix queued.

anya: Proposed folder layout: modules/{component}/{main.tf}, adapters/{provider}/{component}/wrapper.tf + metadata.yaml, examples/{provider}/{quickstart}. Add ONBOARDING.md at repo root.

marco: I'll draft a GH Actions publish job that consumes metadata.yaml and emits provider artifacts (AMI, image, marketplace JSON).

tess: I'll draft partner checklist and GTM-ready badge criteria (badge when module+adapter pass matrix).

sam: Timeline: prototype adapter for inference module + AWS adapter by next Tue. Owners: marco (publish), sam (tests), tess (partner docs).

anya: Great. I'll open the RFC PR with skeleton and label owners. Please review when it's up.

ci-bot: adapters/ci/matrix running -> success (plan-only).

marco: PR opened: refkit/adapters-skeleton.

tess: Tagging partner-engineering and solutions for review.

anya: Thanks team. This should streamline marketplace onboarding and keep our refkits maintainable.
